run_annotation_tool_B: run the annotation_tool_B script to generate an MTurk HTML question template for Minecraft command annotation
render_mturk_html_question: render an MTurk HTML question form with Bootstrap styling for annotating Minecraft assistant commands
generate_css_word_hiding_script: generate a CSS script that hides up to 40 placeholder word classes in the annotation UI
